eligibility.quote: Issue #3239 (title "Add Controller Benchmark to tools/benchmarks then break out the benchmarks into a new package") body: "Probably the same random environment with some static path we use and then take metrics like time to goal, distance traversed, \"smoothness\" of velocities and behaviors in some metrics, closeness to obstacles, maybe maximum possible run-time." Maintainer SteveMacenski: "Closing as wontfix for now since this has been open for 3 years with little progress and isn't a run-time feature in the Nav2 stack for deployed use"

loudness.quote: No defect, no diagnostic: the issue is a feature request, closed "Closing as wontfix for now ... (a nice-to-have tool that hasn't been nice-enough-to-have for any companies or organizations to focus on it)"

resolution.quote: PR #3236 "Add Path Smoothers Benchmarking suite" merged 2022-10-14 — adds a smoother benchmark under tools/smoother_benchmarking and fixes no reported defect; the issue itself was closed wontfix.

notes: Independently verified: issue #3239 title and body verbatim (a benchmarking-tool feature request with tutorials, no defect report, no reproducer, no error); the closing comment 2896100909 by SteveMacenski verbatim; PR #3236's title and 2022-10-14 merge date. The incidental discussion items the spec cites are real: the comment "The costmap is ordered, so the inflation has to be after the static layer for it to be applied" appears in the thread (maintainer attributing the contributor's inflation-layer non-effect to plugin order in the contributor's own WIP config) and is not the reported problem. My independent reading: E1 requires a documented concrete defect with reproducer, error log, or maintainer confirmation of a defect — a feature request closed wontfix provides none, so E1 fails and no two-unit interaction is identifiable (E2 stops at step 1 with no reason code, as the spec records). The spec's own label 'no_documented_defect' for the E1 failure is transparently flagged as the author's choice since the E2 reason codes do not cover E1. Ineligible stands.
